commentkeyword-agent-toolkit-comment-to-.description: Plan the "Comment KEYWORD and I'll DM you the link" call to action of an Instagram Reel or post, then set up the automatic DM in CommentKeyword so every commenter actually gets it. Use when editing, scripting, captioning or publishing a short-form video whose CTA asks viewers to comment a word, when adding an animated comment box, comment-to-DM end card or keyword CTA to a video (Remotion or other code-based editing), or when the user asks to set up comment-to-DM, "comment X to get Y", or a keyword auto-DM on Instagram.
